primary_comparison: ridge_sr minus adam, separately on each geometry; energy and variance on frozen terminal states. Lower-lr Adam is secondary. All arms must complete 128 steps before describing training samples/full-H calls as matched. Compare actual CPU time too; no equal-wall-time or GPU-efficiency claim.
initialization: Restore identical model from sealed step 1064. Retain inherited Adam moments for both Adam arms. SR uses no Adam moments. Generate one common pool of 64 fresh chains and training PRNG per geometry, burn at the frozen parent, then fork identically for all three arms. Actual configurations diverge after training; common RNG is not identical sampling. This is a forked optimizer comparison, not bitwise continuation of the old 32-chain run.
budgets: 128 attempted updates x64 full-H centers=8192 training calls/arm; 600 active training seconds/arm emergency cap, at most one-step overrun. Shared compilation warmup=64 calls/geometry; 4 frozen states x3072 audit calls/geometry. Planned total 73856 full-H calls across two geometries. Compilation/thermalization/audits reported separately. No candidate-energy calls in SR backtracking. Local CPU only; estimated 30-40 minutes plus tests. No automatic extension or tuning.
inference: All audits use mutually disjoint fresh random seeds, after every arm on that lattice has trained. Differences are unpaired whole-chain bootstrap (not paired SE). Report primary marginal 95% intervals and 98.75% Bonferroni intervals for 2 lattices x2 primary observables. Conditional sampling intervals do not certify equilibration or unobserved tails. No best-checkpoint or best-seed selection. Preserve every arm, rejection and cost cap. No architecture/SU2/frontier win is inferred from an optimizer win.
scope: Architecture, parameter count (4032), full Hamiltonian, fixed Sz=0, exact spatial Gamma-A1 and projector are unchanged. No direct-fusion, OF, ED, new carrier, remote submission or paper-notebook promotion. Larger batch relative to previous work is common to all arms; this experiment isolates optimizer policies at batch64, not the causal effect of batch size alone.
method_reference: Chen and Heyl, Nature Physics 20,1476-1481(2024), https://www.nature.com/articles/s41567-024-02566-1 : sample-space SR identity. This fixed real-parameter ridge/trust implementation is not a reproduction of their full MinSR training recipe.
